title: Early Nahuatl Library (Wired Humanities Projects)
notes: Online library of colonial Nahuatl manuscripts with transcriptions and analytic translations; this entry counts a selection of 16 documents. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Wired Humanities Projects, University of Oregon (ed. Stephanie Wood)
